response.what_it_is: Packaged bedding set containing a duvet, bedsheet, and pillowcases with sunflower pattern
hidden_risks: fabric material composition (cotton vs polyester blend)
exact thread count and tactile feel
actual dimensions and bed size compatibility
thickness and quality of the inner duvet filling
response.best_proof: A photo of the items fully unfolded on a bed or a close-up of the material tag
response.failure_mode: Mistaking the packaged bedding set for a single large pillow or cushion, or accepting the incorrect 'bed frame' label.
